exam.exam_name: MPSC General Online Application Photograph Instruction

source_evidence.captured_wording: 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; 50 KB; .jpg or .jpeg; solid colour background; preferably blue, green or red; no shadows; directly facing the camera
source_evidence.document_title: Instructions for Filling the Application Form

dimensions.fallback_reason: No pixel dimensions are published by the conducting body. The output size is chosen per photograph from the crop geometry rather than from a fixed default.

requirements.content_instructions: Uploaded candidate photograph; format: JPG/JPEG; file size: up to 50 KB; background: preferably blue, green or red.
requirements.evidence_status: Evidence tier as recorded in supplied photograph report
rejection_conditions: Shadows on the face or background are not accepted.
Non-frontal or side-facing pose can fail the stated requirement.

requirements.content_instructions: JPG/JPEG; maximum 50 KB; 3.5 cm × 1.5 cm; no minimum published

requirements.applicability: Candidates claiming reservation, disability, domicile, age relaxation, experience or a post-specific qualification
requirements.content_instructions: Upload only the certificate explicitly requested by that examination and category. The exact list is notification-specific and was not fully established in the supplied photograph evidence.

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Instructions for Filling the Application Form - Photograph instructions (https://mpsconline.gov.in/downloads/Instructions-for-Filling-the-Application-Form.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: The conducting body publishes no pixel dimensions. The output size is chosen per photograph from the crop geometry, so no dimension is asserted on the body's behalf.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.

requirements[1].file_spec.formats.allowe.reasoning: No published file format for this deliverable. Standing in with JPG, which is the only format any body in the researched set publishes for a signature, thumb impression or handwritten declaration.

requirements[2].file_spec.file_size.maxi.reasoning: No published file size for this certificate, and none for any of the 45 certificate deliverables in the research, so no distribution exists to stand in for. 400 KB is a product-owner working ceiling pending the published figures. No minimum is set: a floor on top of an invented ceiling would compound the guess.
